_note: Display settings only. Brands, filters and prices come from the watch files. brand_order lists brand slugs to show first; featured_brands are shown before the rest (default: the featured tier in config.json); hidden_brands are never shown. planned_filters shows an option dimmed before any watch has it, for example {"water": ["200-plus"]}. brand_names overrides the name made from a new brand's slug. intent_cards: the four discovery cards. A card is shown only when approved is true, it has a filter ({group, value}) and at least one watch matches; the owner approves the label and the filter together. budget_discovery: the shopper price tiers shown on /watches/ and in the menu, built from every live watch (not from the approved SEO pages). tiers are price band slugs from config.json; premium_after is the band where the Premium group starts above; menu lists the tiers (and 'premium') shown in the menu, in order; descriptions optionally overrides the neutral one-line description of a tier by its id (draft or default copy only; an approved summary in collections.json always wins). Every part of budget_discovery is optional and falls back to safe defaults.
